apply_policy: Jointly review and resolve prerequisites; apply only to a dedicated QA relay in organization steven. Never overwrite production deployment, queues, pools, templates or secrets. Restart the QA relay after one overlay at a time and record its redacted config hash.
unresolved: Confirm separate QA relay and both provider entitlements/credentials
Confirm provisioner name, tags, host, socket access, shared-host isolation, concurrency and capacity
Confirm coderd build-secret capability and template/module compatibility
Confirm QA template slug and exact active version UUIDs
Confirm status UI private access and org-wide reader permission

docker_provider.status: candidate local provisioner socket; privileged, verify provisioner process permissions and host isolation before use

listener_policy: 0.0.0.0 is acceptable only on a private network with controlled local port-forward. Do not publicly expose 2113 without TLS and authenticated access. Probe /readyz and /metrics via a private forward to the QA pod, even when Kubernetes marks the pod not ready. Authenticate status UI through /login; do not assume /api/status accepts a token header.
public_evidence_policy: Store only redacted IDs, UTC timestamps, hashes, status/build metadata, sanitized counters and summarized observations. No secrets, emails, raw provider transcripts, work orders, debug logs or credential-bearing state.
